facts.statement: The study addresses the problem that hair blocks good contact between electrodes and skin during brain signal recording.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Researchers created a method called eHAIR that turns hair into an electronic interface using special conductive polymer dyes.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The team tested two methods using polythiophene dyes: one for quickly coating groups of hairs and another for semi-permanent coating of single hairs.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The new interface created low-resistance connections that produced stronger brain signals with better frequency details, all without needing gels or hard devices.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The system can also amplify signals locally using transistors where the amount of amplification depends on the shape of the hair.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The authors present this as a wearable platform that works on single hairs or larger areas covered in hair.
facts.subject: computational
